notes.title: Patch notes 1.13 from 5.9.2024
notes.notes: Fixed the work of the "Winged" circuit.

notes.title: Patch notes 1.1 from 11.2.2024:
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] The death of all Decembrists during the demonstration no longer leads to defeat (via game freeze)
[*] Clicking on a deceased Decembrist's portrait no longer leads to defeat (via game freeze)
[*] Galina's armor now increases durability in addition to protection.
[/list]

notes.title: Content Patch 1.1 from 1.2.2024
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Characters now display their unique avatars instead of cropped sprites in messaging conversations.
[*] 
[*] On "Postgraduate" and "Doctoral" difficulty levels, opponents can use highly saturated ash, depending on how many domains they have left.
[*] 
[*] On "Doctoral" difficulty in the necromog, you may encounter a more dangerous opponent than a ghost, cadaver or skeleton. The reward for defeating them is increased by 25%.
[*] 
[*] Boris and Evgeniy are no longer strengthened or weakened by difficulty level.
[*] 
[*] Bug fixes:
[*] 
[*] The phone no longer disappears after the first lecture and dialogue with Georgiy.
[*] 
[*] An unused 174MB video clip has been removed from the game.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch notes 1.08 from 20.1.2024:
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] The game no longer breaks if you take Valeria as your partner for the second tournament fight
[*] The correct partners are now shown next to the Kirill clone on day 15
[*] Galina no longer offers to start making armor even after you've already started making it with her
[*] The phone is removed from the skills screen to avoid interfering with leveling up the Corsican branch
[*] You can level up skills in the arena again
[*] Clicking Igor's portrait during the demonstration now scrolls the partner list instead of causing an infinite loop
[*] Added voiceover for Igor in the Decembrists branch
[*] If you danced with Galina at the ball but didn't start a relationship, then talked to Yevgeniy, the game continues instead of making you contemplate your life infinitely
[*] Increased regeneration from the Manchu skill "Supporting Сircuits" to 5 per turn instead of 2
[/list]

notes.title: Patch notes 1.07 from 17.1.2024:
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] The entire roster no longer comes to the rally even if you didn't invite them
[*] When summoning Lera to the demonstration, the correct dialogues now play
[*] Fixed a bug where after winning/losing the demonstration the player would see the main hall and Kirill's shadow instead of the ending
[*] Igor can now be invited to the rally
[*] Fixed one of Georgy's epilogues
[/list]

notes.title: Patch notes 1.06 from 16.1.2024:
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Lera's cake no longer duplicates in inventory
[*] On spending time with Igor, the "Express agreement/disagreement" choice is no longer inverted
[*] Fixed a typo in the tutorial for Georgy's mission
[*] You can no longer invite Lera to the rally if you asked her to settle down, regardless of relationship level (she declined anyway)
[*] Georgy has stopped being generous and takes back his owed 1,000 rubles if you invite him to any fight
[*] You can no longer ask Galina on a date if you have no time left that day
[*] No more bets are placed on the fight with Yekaterina Trubetskaya
[*] You can no longer get info on an already researched opponent after deceiving Milana
[*] If you scold Galina while she takes your measurements, she will no longer agree to make armor for you
[*] Completing the plasteel armor now correctly grants the "Walking Tank" achievement
[*] The third fight in the dueling club properly grants a new circuit
[*] No longer receive double XP for fights in the dueling club
[*] Added an extra autosave after the first tournament win
[*] When Galina asks about your girlfriend and you choose to evade the question, you no longer tell her about your dream girl
[*] In one chat with Galina, choosing "reply" no longer just makes her repeat the question
[*] Galina no longer text to discuss armor edits after you've fully completed the  armor
[*] Boris's knuckleduster can now be equipped in the second weapon slot too
[*] Reading descriptions before Yevgeny gets to Galina no longer breaks descriptions
[*] You can no longer go to sleep while an item description is on screen and vice versa
[/list]

notes.title: Patch notes 1.05 from 13.1.2024:
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Valeria no longer deradicalizes after the 5th dialogue with her
[*] You can no longer spend time twice on the assignment in the necromog
[*] Georgiy stops being a partner after the fight with him
[*] Music no longer duplicates during battles
[*] The dialogue on the morning of December 23rd now starts automatically instead of requiring a button press
[*] Fixed bugs in the English localization
[*] The phone should disappear less frequently after attending a lecture
[/list]

notes.title: Patch notes 1.04 from 13.1.2024:
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Fixed game-breaking dialogue with Valeria in English localization (effective in a new game)
[*] Fixed inability to get details about opponent when talking to Milana in English localization (effective in a new game)
[*] Boris no longer says one of Valeria's random lines in dialogue with him
[*] Milana no longer scares Kirill by teleporting back and forth if he cheats on her with Valeria (effective in a new game)
[*] Can gift presents again in English localization
[*] First text message in chat in English localization is now in English
[*] The system now gives Kirill one thousand rubles before the last tournament fight, in case he only has Georgiy unlocked and Evgeniy is "unavailable" as a partner
[/list]

notes.title: Patch notes 1.03 from 12.1.2024:
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Fixed infinite dialogue loop with Valeria before the finale if you are in a relationship
[*] After losing to yourself, the game continues normal functioning after giving the achievement
[*] After dancing with Evgeny at relationship <30, the game continues normal functioning
[*] The "Combat Clash" circuit has the correct damage values
[*] The "Winged" circuit correctly increases its stats
[*] Evgeniy less frequently uses Boris's emotions during dialogues
[*] Boris uses the correct audio lines during the ball
[/list]

notes.title: Patch notes 1.02 from 12.1.2024:
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Fixed the initiation of a fight after pressing space
[*] Fixed the rare dialogue with Georgy when he says that some activities are not available in a demo
[/list]

notes.title: Patch notes 1.01 from 12.1.2024:
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Improved audio quality for Galina's audio files
[*] Added Yekaterina's story. Can you unlock it?
[*] Fixed the ability to move circuits diagonally
[*] Fixed the description for the "Winged" circuit
[/list]
